development_reasons: per-run values from a CSV (--runs), not from the run directories
independence: imports only the standard library and numpy; neither imports nor reads framelease_v4/analysis/* or framelease_v4/arms/metrics_v4.py (only their outputs)

interim_guard.rule: PROTOCOL Sec. 9.11: no test-route result is examined before the analysis freeze

scope.rule: the not_verified Table I columns are not recomputed here and may not enter the paper on this verification (Sec. 9.12)

tolerances.absent: every expected file, column and field is compared; an absent one is a difference
tolerances.bootstrap_exact: both sides with the registered resamples and seed (n_boot 10000, boot_seed 20261110): each CI endpoint within 1e-09 (the bootstrap_window is reported in the note as a diagnostic)
tolerances.bootstrap_window: otherwise an endpoint at level p lies within [q(p - delta), q(p + delta)] (+-1e-9) of this script's own replicates, delta = 5 sqrt(p (1 - p) (1 / B_mine + 1 / B_theirs)) (= 5 sqrt(2 p (1 - p) / 10000) at the registered B)
tolerances.exact: counts, route sets, labels, statements, outcome classes equal; per-route values, means, sums, medians, minima, maxima, exact and Holm-adjusted p-values within 1e-09
tolerances.monte_carlo: |p_mc - p_exact| <= 5 sqrt(p_exact (1 - p_exact) / M) + 2 / (M + 1); an empty p_mc at n > 22 is a difference
tolerances.stated: in the module docstring before any comparison was run (bootstrap_exact fixed on 2026-11-14, before any test-route input)
